Catholic clergy demand international probe into Chemmani mass grave
by abilash
Fri, 31/07/2026 - 20:40
Body
The Catholic clergy led a peaceful demonstration in Jaffna on Thursday, demanding justice for victims of the Chemmani–Siththuppaththi mass grave and calling for an independent international investigation into the site.
